Our server Mila (Milagros) was RUDE and AGGRESSIVE
Mar 2025 • Couples
Just left Lucali in sunset harbour. 
I’m shocked of how awful the service was. Our waitress was Mila (Milagros) and I can honestly say she was the worst server I’ve ever encountered. 
I’m a local and a couple months ago was invited to a private event where we met and made pizza with the owner, Mark Lacono. He was incredibly nice to us and encouraged us to please come back, so tonight we did go back. 
Mila (Milagros) came to take our water order, the second she heard still water she turned around while we were still talking (we wanted to order drinks since we waited so long for her to show up) after about 10-15 minutes I politely put my hand up and smiled to get her attention and let’s just say that was the beginning of the end. She literally mocked me from afar, put her hand up back at me and rolled her eyes. I was so offended. My friend said look, she’s “staring you down”from the other table, I look over and she’s literally giving me a dirty look. 
What the hell? Is Mila actually mocking me then giving me dirty looks? We were all pretty shocked. 
But wait, it gets worse. I get up to ask the host where the bathroom is and to ask for the waitress’s name. (So that I never sit in her section again) 
The young host took the liberty to tell Mila that I asked for her name to when I return to the table from the bathroom Mila rushes the table and aggressively says “you want to know my name, it’s Mila” she was so pissed her face was red. My friends and I were speechless. It was literally aggressive, and completely unacceptable. 

Mark, we really loved you. We had a great time when Faena took us there but today Milagros had it out for me, her dislike for me made her incredibly unprofessional which ruined it for the entire table. 
If this wasn’t bad enough, the first two pizzas that came out were completely wrong! Bad service is one thing, but to have a staff member act in such an immature way was just unacceptable. 
Eye rolling, mocking me when trying to get her attention, dirty looks and confronting us about asking her name, really? We were left so disappointed. 
This was March 5th, we sat at the round table in front, next to the window at 6:35pm.
